تلتحمون (form VIII)
# تَلْتَحِمُونَ (taltaḥimūna) /tal.ta.ħi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# تُلْتَحَمُونَ (tultaḥamūna) /tul.ta.ħa.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
